mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_EN_NAME, ITEM_NICK_NAME, ITEM_CODE, BUY_COST, TAX_COST, AGENT_COST, CLIENT_COST, STOCK, MEMO FROM CM_BIKE_ITEM_DTL WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND USE_BIT = 'Y' AND BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL = #{bikeItemSerial} ORDER BY SERIAL_NUMBER

SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_EN_NAME, ITEM_NICK_NAME, ITEM_CODE, BUY_COST, TAX_COST, AGENT_COST, CLIENT_COST, STOCK, MEMO FROM CM_BIKE_ITEM_DTL WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_BIKE_ITEM_DTL ( REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_EN_NAME, ITEM_NICK_NAME, ITEM_CODE, BUY_COST, TAX_COST, AGENT_COST, CLIENT_COST, STOCK, MEMO ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{registIp}, 'N', '00', #{useBit}, #{bikeItemSerial}, #{itemName}, #{itemEnName}, #{itemNickName}, #{itemCode}, #{buyCost}, #{taxCost}, #{agentCost}, #{clientCost}, #{stock}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM_DTL SET MODIFY_DATE = NOW(), MODIFY_IP = #{modifyIp}, USE_BIT = #{useBit}, ITEM_NAME = #{itemName}, ITEM_EN_NAME = #{itemEnName}, ITEM_NICK_NAME = #{itemNickName}, ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode}, BUY_COST = #{buyCost}, TAX_COST = #{taxCost}, AGENT_COST = #{agentCost}, CLIENT_COST = #{clientCost}, STOCK = #{stock}, MEMO = #{memo} WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM_DTL SET CANCEL_BIT = 'Y', CANCEL_DATE = NOW() WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
